steps.title: Analyze model URL issues
steps.description: Identify that the existing Qwen Hugging Face repository URLs return 404 and find stable replacement URLs.

steps.title: Update GGUF model download URLs
steps.description: Replace outdated Qwen URLs in MainActivity.java with currently active URLs from the bartowski repository.

steps.title: Enable manual redirection handling
steps.description: Set connection.setInstanceFollowRedirects(false) and manually loop to follow redirect paths up to 8 hops.

steps.title: Add connection and read timeouts
steps.description: Set connection timeout to 20s and read timeout to 30s to prevent hanging download threads.

steps.title: Include standard User-Agent header
steps.description: Assign a modern desktop browser User-Agent header to the request to avoid cloud blockages.

steps.title: Implement safe .part file downloads
steps.description: Stream the data into a temporary .part file instead of directly writing to the destination target path.

steps.title: Handle cancellation clean up
steps.description: Safely delete the partial .part file if the download is cancelled by the user during the process.

steps.title: Implement download size validation
steps.description: Validate that the file is fully downloaded and has a size greater than 100MB before renaming and moving.

steps.title: Fix content-length unknown state logic
steps.description: Provide a safe fallback in UI update calculations when fileLength is -1 or empty.

steps.title: Preserve existing offline logic
steps.description: Keep local scan behaviors and mock engine fallback functions exactly as they were.

steps.title: Building Offline AI Chat
steps.description: Compile, bundle, and assemble the debug APK without external dependencies.
